blurb: This check confirms that the AIX release is still inside the IBM standard support window, so it keeps receiving security fixes. A release past its end-of-support date no longer gets IBM security fixes, leaving newly disclosed CVEs open on the host; the check flags it for upgrade to a supported release, with a Software Support Service Extension only as a bridge. On a VIOS, or when not running as root, the check does not assess and reports NOT_ASSESSED.
